note: Damascus was covered but badly underweighted. The late move toward Amman overreacted to Zelenskyy's Jordan itinerary and the generic phrase 'important meeting'; neither item identified the Syrian president. Syria's home-capital base rate and the explicit bilateral nature of the forecast should have kept Damascus at least co-favorite. The final distribution's approximate Brier skill was only 0.02, versus roughly 0.35 for the prior 36% Amman / 29% Damascus distribution, illustrating the cost of chasing a weak late clue.
